scope.unit: One physically distinct cache directory per saved request. Different retry/repeat directories are separate attempts even when payload hashes match.
excludes: this audit and other assistant-side orchestration/model use outside the recorded experiment APIs
scope.coverage_limit: Complete inventory of the two retained experiment API cache trees, not an independent provider billing statement. Request-only records cannot prove network dispatch.

counting_policy.successful_provider_response: Cached provider response with choices/usage; does not imply parse, AST validation, calibration, oracle correctness or experiment success.
counting_policy.usage: Sum top-level response.usage.total_tokens once per distinct call; never add nested billing_usage copies or manifest copies.
counting_policy.missing_usage: Unknown, never treated as zero consumption. Known token sums are partial totals.
counting_policy.fees: Only explicit provider monetary fee/cost/price/currency/charge/amount fields are searched, excluding message bodies; none found. No public-price estimate or claimed zero fee.
counting_policy.failure_categories: Network outcome, length limit, output validation and calibration are separate axes and may overlap.
counting_policy.replay: Reusing cached model output generates zero new experimental API calls.

notes: Only request.json is retained. Dispatch, outcome and usage cannot be established from these files. An earlier session summary reported timeout, but no independently citable timeout log was retained; this ledger keeps outcome unknown.
Initially rejected NamedExpr; the interpreter was extended and the unchanged cached predicate revalidated. No additional model call for revalidation.
